summary: Comprehensive backend API tests for BizMarket B2B Marketplace. 35/35 pytest cases pass against external URL covering public catalog (categories, companies, services, plans, ads, blog), full auth flow (login/demo-login/register/me with Bearer token), buyer flow (briefs, proposals received, shortlist, dashboard), provider flow (company CRUD, services CRUD, leads, proposals sent, analytics), admin flow (stats, companies actions, users/reviews/leads/briefs, ads/plans/settings/integrations/audit-logs), and full RBAC matrix (buyer<->provider<->admin endpoint isolation + unauthenticated 401).

minor.issue: Authentication priority is cookie > Authorization header. If a stale access_token cookie exists in the client from a previous login, a subsequent request with a different Bearer token is silently ignored and the cookie identity wins. This bit the test harness (10/35 failed initially). Recommend: prefer Authorization header over cookie, OR clear cookie on every login response before setting a new one. Not a blocker but a real correctness/security smell.

allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Should use explicit origin from env (e.g. CORS_ORIGINS) or disable credentials. Cookie httponly/secure/samesite=none are set correctly otherwise.
Password complexity is not enforced (e.g. accepts 'x' as password in negative tests). Recommend Pydantic validator for min length.
Body is typed as plain dict — no Pydantic validation. Allows arbitrary keys to be persisted into plans/settings/integrations docs.
verified/min_rating/size filters work, but 'verified=false' is treated as None by FastAPI Optional[bool]; only 'true' takes effect (string parsing). Minor.

action_items: Recommended: in get_current_user, prefer Authorization header over cookie, or always overwrite/clear access_token cookie on every login. Otherwise a client retaining a stale cookie will be authenticated as the wrong user.
Recommended: replace CORS allow_origins=['*'] with explicit origins from env when allow_credentials=True.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 932 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, public, buyer, provider, admin).
Many admin PUT endpoints accept untyped dict body — add Pydantic schemas.
Auth precedence (cookie before header) makes role switching from same browser session error-prone; document or invert order.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook expectation: lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented.
test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@bizmarket.az/Admin123!, buyer@bizmarket.az/Buyer123!, provider@bizmarket.az/Provider123! — all valid.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed needed. Backend self-seeds on startup (20 categories, 4 plans, 12 companies, demo users). Tests create TEST_ prefixed briefs/services/proposals; not cleaned up (low volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints in the review_request are working and asserted. Bearer-auth path tested; cookie path implicitly works since login sets cookie. IMPORTANT for next agent: server prefers cookie over Authorization header — if you share one requests.Session across roles, clear cookies between role switches or use isolated sessions. backend_test.py demonstrates the pattern (autouse _clear_session_cookies fixture).
rca_of_initial_test_failures: 10 initial failures were caused by the test harness, not the app: pytest's session-scoped requests.Session accumulated an access_token cookie from earlier /auth/login calls; server's get_current_user checks cookie BEFORE Authorization header, so the cookie identity overrode the Bearer token for subsequent authed tests. Fixed by adding autouse fixture that clears session.cookies before/after every test, and by giving each role its own isolated session in _login(). All 35 tests pass after fix.
